_note: Frozen evaluation config (RE-AUDIT §04). Change it only with a new version and a note in METHODOLOGY.md. Thresholds are the shadow-mode starting settings in detectors.py at this version; they are not tuned on these results. r4: thresholds unchanged (not tuned); two baselines added; objective stated in EVALUATION.md. r5: objective fixed to A; universe and thresholds frozen (see frozen); adjudication rules in ADJUDICATION.md.

universe.polymarket: highest-volume open non-sports market with CLOB history at run time (recorded in the output)

labels.kind: scheduled official release days (FOMC decision, CPI, Employment Situation) from data/event-calendar.json
labels.meaning: a day with a known public information release; NOT a label for informed or unusual trading

split.holdout: second half of sessions (reported separately, never used to choose thresholds)

pointInTime.treasury: each session uses rows[0..i] only; availability estimated 18:00 ET
pointInTime.polymarket: price history sliced to each point; 24h volume is NOT point-in-time (vol24 None, vol24AsOf = fetch time), so volume-gated findings are rejected (REPLAY-01)

volNormalizedSingle.rule: |daily change| / stdev of the prior 20 daily changes >= 3 on 2Y, 10Y or 30Y (one series at a time, no cross-tenor or curve logic)

calendarOnly.rule: flag every session that is a scheduled FOMC/CPI/NFP release day, with no market data
calendarOnly.note: identical to the label by construction: it shows the current label measures calendar association, not information outside the calendar

newsTimeline.why: no free, point-in-time first-publication/news archive is available to this project; not substituted

objective.releaseText: characterize unusual moves: describe what moved, how unusual relative to its own history, with evidence and coverage limits
objective.excludedWhy: forecasting scheduled-day volatility is answered by a calendar; not a product goal
objective.researchWhy: information outside the public calendar needs a point-in-time news timeline that does not exist here; future research only

frozen.thresholdsFrom: lib/grok_the_block/markets/detectors.py at commit f100071 (unchanged in r5; not tuned on any result)

universe.polymarket: highest-volume open non-sports market with CLOB history at run time (recorded in the output)

frozen.liveUniverse: skills/signals/config defaults at f100071 (equities/options/crypto/macro/treasury/prediction lists as shipped)
frozen.changePolicy: a change needs a new config version, a METHODOLOGY.md note, and a re-run of every track; results produced before the change are not compared as if comparable
